about: Authored schema for this lane only. One row per move, computed from the lane's own move/species data. No third-party data staged.

row.move_id: lane move id (from lane move DB, never another game's id)

rules: Every row filled before a balance PR.
One variable changed at a time, with a changelog line.
Outlier flags are review prompts, not auto-nerfs — a human (Step 5 agent + parent) decides.

wiring_target.target_module: playtest harness + balance report, checked by Step 6 before lock
